text:
QUOTE: "unless the repo declares an `index_scope:` in its `.clew.yaml`, clew indexes the whole repository" and "nothing declared (the default) ── whole_repo_scope(repo)"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a declared `index_scope` is used when present and that the whole repository is indexed whenever none is found. It also notes `derive_scope` alone falls back to whole-repo when a declaration is unusable, though the CLI refuses in that case.
